hook: Iguazú River hit 17,700 m³/s, temporarily closing the park on October 2026.

sections.voiceover: Iguazú River hit 17,700 m³/s, temporarily closing the park on October 2026.
October 2026’s Super El Niño dumped rain on the Brazil‑Argentina border. Why did the surge force the Circuito Superior walkway to close?
But the water rose twelve times the average, far worse than forecasts.
Scientists linked the extreme flow to the Super El Niño event. Visitors missed the chance to see the falls as flow peaked at 17,700 m³/s.
The record 17,700 m³/s flow remains unmatched to date.
